Very slight softness/haloing around the left ear tip where it meets the out-of-focus background, potentially indicating minor edge blending issues common in generative models.

To verify the structural integrity of the visible limbs and ensure no extra/missing digits or fused joints, despite the 'limbed' rule usually applying to larger mammals, rabbits have complex limb structures worth auditing.
